name: Taiwan Shin Kong Security Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Shin Kong Security Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides electronic security services in Taiwan. It operates through Electronic Services Business, Cash-In-Transit Business, Stationed Security Business, and Other segments. The company engages in the design, sale, rental, installation, maintenance, repair, and inspection of disaster prevention, theft prevention, and fire protection equipment; and import and export of related products. It also provides cash escort and permanent security guard services.
